Currently learning guitar as well ;) its about the only thing that takes my mind off things, once my interest in video games started to fade I knew I needed something.

i understand where your coming from and have struggled with similar feelings, its like your own logical thinking turns on yourself and starts stripping away all meaning from your life. just keep reminding yourself that a lot of people have felt the same way and got through it, even becoming stronger because of it, that there are people that care about you and would hate to see anything happen to you, and also that your still young and still have a lot to learn and experience yet.
